english: The mimic unveils its appearance from the sign.
Big steely man!
And smaller, pretty man!
The goblin clearly, and outwardly, cringes.
You stare at the sign.
Your companion joins in on the staring as well.
It does indeed say, Not A Mimic.
It speaks to you.
What speaks to me?
Who put this sign here?
So I'm assuming the chest is a mimic, then?
Figure out what's off about this whole setup.
(Touch the sign.)
(Look at the sign.)
E-Hm.
The maw.
It is waiting.
But do not fear.
It is a friend.
Look, the stomach says what it wants to say.
Sometimes the bones speak truth.
But this time, you are not so sure what that truth even means.
Friend.
An interesting question.
Could be a team of sign-makers who go around the City Below planting helpful signs.
That would be lovely.
However, there is most likely a more esoteric explanation.
There are many mysteries in the City Below. Including the shifting tunnels, and strangely intense esoteric pockets.
Normally magic like this would be quite rare this close to the Coast, but the City Below is special.
So this sign could very well be a manifestation of an esoteric event.
In other words, the sign could very well be a natural phenomenon of Jor.
The sign clearly says the opposite.
The sign appears to point towards that, yes.
However, this whole area is clearly esoteric in nature. So beware.
My 'goblin buddies'?
He does not enjoy the tone of that phrase.
Yeah, you know. The gobros.
Do you not have any friends, Snell?
Just answer the question.
The what now?
Does he not know the lingo?
The grubgobs.
He glares at you.
Try some others.
The gobbuds?
Your snagglepals?
Uh... like, gremleenies?
What about ghoulies?
The goblin holds up a finger.
Don't use that word anymore.
Oh. Is that a goblin-only word?
No, not at all.
But it doesn't mean what you think it does.
Beyond that...
He's just like you.
For real.
That's not-
He stops himself.
No, Cleric.
I can guarantee: no one from the Halfways put this sign up.
(Grab the sign.)
(Don't grab the sign.)
Hold on.
Hold ON.
What?
Look at the sign.
I've been doing that for a while now. What about it?
Ask yourself one basic question.
How is the sign attached to the wall?
Well, obviously it's... the nail. Up there.
Yes. But look at it.
(Inspect it closer.) Oh. It's not...?
That nail is not attached to the wood. Nor does it hang upon anything else apparent.
Could be attached at the back?
That would be a strange way to hang a basic sign like this.
That's true.
A man would just hammer right through it.
More importantly, why would the rope still be erect in this fashion?
It is as if someone attempted to create a facsimile of a hanging sign, and did not think through all the logical steps involved with why each piece is assembled.
So... what about it?
It's suspicious.
Yeah, that much was obvious from the start. What do I do about it?
See those pebbles on the ground?
Toss one of them at the sign.
A basic test of corporeality.
Corpo-what?
(Toss a pebble at the sign.)
(Just grab the sign instead.)
Just do it.
No!
Nope.
You have no idea.
But you should probably be careful.
You should see if there is something behind the sign, perhaps?
You do notice a slight gap at the side of the sign.
A gap in the wall. There's something behind it, perhaps.
Mm.
Hm?
Why do I feel like I could... touch the sign?
It is but one possibility out of many.
Perhaps you should think about it first.
Think about it a lot.
That is the only way to truly investigate something.
Not true.
You can use your eyes as well.
It is a sign.
It says, 'Not A Mimic.'
The second your gloved hand touches the surface of the sign, you realize something is off.
Mainly because it's soft.
And then...
The many, many long teeth dig into your hand.
Breaking the skin, crushing the bone.
I knew it!
No he didn't.
A dozen eyes spawn from nowhere across the wooden surface, which is quickly turning rubbery and wriggling.
(Scream and flail.)
Your hand is stuck, nailed within the maw of the Beast.
I'm on it!
It lets out a gurgling chortling noise as it vibrates upon the wall.
Friend.
You need to prove yourself here. Take the pain!
Go deeper!
As the creature chews upon your flesh, you seem to recall an interesting factoid.
NOT THE TIME!
It's always time for knowledge. You see, you once read that if you are bitten, lock-jawed by a Beast like this, there's only one thing you should do.
Shove the hand deeper.
Yes. YES.
It's risky. But going deeper might just work.
Whatever you do: do NOT touch it with the other hand.
Wriggle your hand free.
Shove your hand in deeper.
The fist hits a soft surface, and immediately gets stuck.
The mimic makes a gurgling satisfied noise.
Damn it! Don't make it worse!
Wait!
WHAT IS IT?
Push and pull! In and out! Quick!
(Push in your hand a little, and then pull back.)
As you jolt your arm forward, the many sharp little teeth are actually tugged out of your flesh.
Then... you pull back!
Your hand escapes the maw of the Beast.
The slightest touch leaves you unable to control your arm.
As you attempt to wriggle, it causes incredible pain to shoot down your arm.
Shit. You need another method. And quick!
The pain is intense.
It gnaws at you.
Embrace it.
(Ram your entire arm into the maw.)
As you push your arm forward, the many sharp little teeth are actually tugged out of your flesh.
(Go deeper.)
The creature's many eyes go wider and wider.
As the teeth begin to scrape against your elbow, it begins making a squealing, wet noise.
Like a squirrel choking on nuts.
Heh. Nuts.
Then... its maw widens as well.
It's letting you go!
See? Friend.
(Pull out your arm.)
With the teeth just barely not slicing your entire arm into strands of flesh, you quickly rip it out of the mimic's maw.
It is left wheezing and gargling upon the wall.
An incredible pain. What feels like a thousand little knives wriggling around inside your arm.
You cannot handle much more of this.
Your arm is going numb. That will help.
He's already grabbing a nearby rock, and slamming it against the Beast's open eyes.
Just... try to get out of its grip!
But without losing your damn arm!
So demanding. This goblin.
Your arm is a heroically charged muscle-vessel. No aberration will consume it without a fight.
No one will consume it at all, preferably.
It is a friend. Be close.
Shut the fuck up!
Stumbling back, you hold your bleeding hand.
The goblin steps in between you and the monster. "Get back!"
Its many eyes focus on you two, and then...
You grab a pebble off the floor and lightly toss it towards the sign.
Expecting it to bounce right off - it instead... just stops.
It gets stuck on the surface of the sign.
Whoa.
Whoa.
That's a... it's soft?
The pebble stopped as if it hit a wall of soft, sticky honey.
Huh?
As you watch the pebble just sit there on the sign- you also see something emerging.
An eye staring at you.
I knew it!
(Point at it and shout.) "A mimic! A real-life MIMIC!"
Right-o! Hold ON...!
It speaks in a harsh, sharp tone.
It speaks?
You CAN NOT sneak UP on one!
Some-times my mouth cannot contain. It is <wiggle>HUNGER</wiggle>!
Appears there are eyes upon me.
Me who hide in <wiggle>PLAIN-SIGHT</wiggle>.
Interesting. There have been documentation of mimics bred for greater intelligence.
But they are commonly seen as extinct in the current Postwar Era.
It- I- you can talk?!
(Raise your fists, get ready for a fight.)
Talk and think and breathe and bite- I do I do.
All time!
Apology, apology! It is what... what it is!
Oh. I am Mimic? That is why?
The goblin holds up a hand. "I mean, yeah. That makes sense."
No! No!
Peace then! Peace upon thee!
Be friend.
Alright, then. It's time.
Talk this bad boy over to your side. You can do it.
I honestly did not expect you to talk. This is kind of throwing me off a little.
You are a monster. You must be destroyed, clearly.
Do not talk often, no! But you understand?
Yes, I understand you.
Well. You speak strangely.
Understand! That is good.
Ah! Mimic-dialectical it is.
In colony, we speak good. Nice, forward.
Using mouth is... not as speak good.
Peace upon big man with steel hide!
Peace upon big steely man and smaller, pretty man!
That's... hm.
Didn't expect to be called 'pretty' by a mimic today.
You don't want to be destroyed?
I've not heard of monsters calling for peace before.
Uh- yes! It is... as they say, sub-jective!
Don't seek approval from this thing, Cleric.
No! Negative! Do not want!
Okay. Now you do: Peace!
Peace out, brother.
The thing might be hideous, but it's not outwardly aggressive right now.
If you want to reach out to it properly, try to mimic its speech pattern. Pun intended.
Hm. Yes, this monster is not mindless. And while its intentions seem to stem from survival, that is not the most evil of leanings.
Perhaps you can, indeed, hear it out.
Can you trust a monster built to trick people to death?
I want some information out of you, monster.
Are... you... friend?
So... you are... friendly?
R-(Punch it in the central eye.)
Yes! You will!
I want offer deal!
Its eyes stare at you, unblinking, as its maw slowly opens.
I... am... <wiggle>FRIEND</wiggle>.
FRIEND.
The creature makes a nodding-like motion.
I... am!
Central eye!
Well then. Time to talk.
Look, the goblin says, turning away from the monster. "I wouldn't trust this thing at the end of a ten-foot pole, however..."
If you can get some nice info out of it...
He shrugs. "Trust but verify, right?"
So...
The mimic looks around.
I- we- I-
Mission! Wizard told to guard. Stash!
A... stash, eh?
But room change place. Chamber shift. Time <wiggle>PASS</wiggle>.
So... Guard Meek moves. Feeding. Guarding. From people coming from not-dungeon.
The poor little guy has been stuck down here for a very long time.
This monster is... following orders?
That actually sounds quite honorable.
But Meek can talk! Talk a lot! Ask Meek!
Your name is Meek?
Must be lonely down here.
What do you know of this place?
How can you talk?
So you're guarding something?
Where do you come from?
What am I supposed to do with this thing?
Convince the mimic to join your party.
I can... ask it to join the party? Really?
(Look firm and stoic.) "Give me the stash."
R-"I'm tired of this." (Just punch it.)
I'll be back later. Don't leave the city.
Meek! Yes!
That's a great name.
That's a terrible name.
Eh.
Yes-yes!
Yes!
No no.
The mimic's gaze dances across the room for a bit.
I mean, yes! Or no. You are not-nice.
He's about as indecisive as you.
Don't be mean.
You hurt the little guy's feelings. I'm not sure that's in your best interest here.
Eh?
Eh?
Eh...
Ah! Not alone always.
Colony is somewhere in past and west. Long time spent in colony.
Most are very dumb in colony. They do not enjoy smart.
They kick out. Not <wiggle>allowed</wiggle> to smart.
You were kicked out because you were too smart?
Anti-intellectualism truly is a cancer upon our realm.
Yeah, you do sound pretty annoying.
The mimic clasps its many teeth together.
It is <wiggle>CURSE</wiggle>. Smart-curse.
How strangely relatable.
Anti... inte? Intellec- intellectually?
Not good, no!
Anno- annoy-ing?
The mimic lets out a sharp growl.
No. You.
He got you there.
I know much! Or...
It shifts around a bit, swaying its gaze.
I know danger and secret.
Place is full of danger and secret. Master told much, and shared little.
But Meek knows! Meek knows!
The mimic could be useful if it shared its secrets.
At least if this master is, as you suspect, a wizard.
Talk? Master made Meek talk!
Master?
Master Haggi- Haggi- <wiggle>HAGGINSHAGS</wiggle>!
Hagginshags? That's one of those Arcanist families, right? Must be an old mimic.
Indeed.
That is one of the great Arcanist families. This mimic must be old. Very old.
They are supposed to be gone by now.
The Hagginshags fell with their empire. The one this mimic speaks of would have to be either an imposter, or... a survivor.
Yes yes!
Most stash is gone. Lost. Or Master took.
But some is here here!
Can I have it?
Where is your master?
M-Seems like the mimic is a pretty decent guardian.
No no! Only Master take stash!
Not here!
Not, not here.
Master gone. Meek alone!
You relate more to this monster right now than you do with most humans on the streets of Norvik.
Indeed. A good wizard's pet.
Every wizard requires a familiar.
Guardian? Yes. Like a familiar of sorts.
A bit too good.
Master! Lair!
It is not close. Place change. Shift.
Here is not where once was and will be.
Suddenly a very complicated sentence.
The mimic is a spontaneous poet.
Take the stash, of course.
It might be unorthodox, but...
There's surely a way to convince this creature to help out.
All monsters need to be defeated. However...
This one does not seem so bad.
This one appears too strange and dangerous for your abilities.
An idea! Okay, an idea.
Yeah?!
To understand this mimic, you have to... try to become the mimic.
Oh no.
I understand. (Attempt to blend into the environment.)
...Cleric?
Your instinct is to curl up on the floor. Naturally.
Being completely still.
(Spend 10 minutes like this.)
As the time passes, you slowly rise again from new ball-shape.
Hm? Oh, you're done?
You stretch your limbs, feeling the power of actually moving - and not being still.
This is idiotic.
Steely man move? Alive? Yes! Good!
You now know a little more of what a mimic life is about.
Mostly, it is feeling pain in your limbs upon a hard stone floor.
Right. So... will this help?
We'll see.
It might, actually. Spending some time on the floor did allow you to think about the life of this mimic.
But of course, you still need to-
You gotta try again. Find one of those shards or something. They usually help.
Those 'shards' are esoterically aligned String-warping artifacts.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. Just use one!
You can do anything. You're The Cleric.
It would help to have more allies. If you can call a mimic, ally.
It would be a lot to handle. But...
If you can get the creature to just hang about and share its 'info', then... why not?
A mimic would be a decent familiar.
The goblin, however, has not proven to be a sufficient servant.
Snell glances at you as you stand there, in silence.
Within the goblin's spirit: a subtle feeling that you're 'shit-talking' him.
No no!
Damn. Your stoic stance must have been too meek.
Damn. If only asking for loot worked more often.
Actually, no, that would remove half the fun.
Explain why you can't just give it to me. Be rational.
That's fair. Sorry for asking.
(Make a long, drawn-out groaning sound.)
The mimic's many eyes just stare blankly forward for a while.
Then it says, "I, I, I..."
Yes?
Stash is Master's!
You are not Master.
That is, in fact, a good argument.
I could be your new Master.
What if I attack you? Could I get it then?
That that-
The monster's mouth hangs open as it freezes mid-speech.
Confusing. Are you good Master? Potenti- potenti-ally?
Very good. In fact, the best. The best Wizard-master ever.
Arguably okay.
Not really, if I'm being honest.
The best? That is big!
Big big!
Okay? Okay can work.
Honest? Good!
Master who lie is bad!
The guy sure likes to view things from a good perspective.
Master of a friend. Yes.
Possible!
Many have fought. I eat some. I run some.
Would you run or flee from me?
Question is good.
In this, in this case, I would run.
Run fast.
Good good!
The mimic stares at you.
(Make another long, drawn-out groaning sound.)
The mimic repeats your sound.
Aaaouuughh...
A poor imitation. You hope.
Okay!
(Leave it.)
Right.
Well, this might seem pretty simple at this point.
But you gotta convince this thing that you'll be its new master.
Oh!
And you do that by... well...
Hey, mimic! Uh... Meek!
When was the last time you saw your Master?
Master? Yes yes! Master was-
It fidgets on the wall.
Master had a- Master say, Meek should- then...
Hm. Meek not see Master for long.
Long long.
There we go. You made those gears start turning.
Now hit him with the big one.
Your old master is gone, Meek.
Oh. But but...!
No buts. He's gone. But it's okay. I will be your new master.
The mimic's eye goes wide, revealing a horrifying mess of shiny pupils.
Then it begins to shake.
No, that does not, does not not.
What?
Only Master can order. Old order, still fresh order.
Hm. Maybe ask...
What exactly was the order?
Order? Master talk: 'Guard Meek guard stash. Guard Meek only order by Master.'
Hm. Well, there's a loophole there.
You're 'Guard' Meek?
Guard is... title.
<wiggle>Title is Guard</wiggle>.
So if you stop having that title, then you're no longer Guard Meek. And thus you don't need to follow the orders.
Meek stares at you for a moment.
It turns to your companion as well.
Uh. Sounds logical to me?
Yes. Yes! That work!
But but... Meek is Guard Meek.
Not anymore! By the power granted to me by the City of Norvik, I now officially deputize you, Mr. Meek.
Whaaat?!
The mimic jolts around on the wall.
Your new title is now Deputy Meek. Congratulations. Wanna join the party?
A horrid screeching sound is emitted from the monster as it leaps towards you.
Shit-shit! the goblin yells and steps back.
(Embrace it.)
Within a moment, you realize that the mimic has left its pose.
And turned into a cloak.
Cloak cloak! I am!
If danger, I tell!
A familiar has joined your party.
Keep familiars equipped to gain bonuses in dice checks.
Depu- Depu-ty Meek at service!
...Are you sure that's safe?
E-"Let's go!"
Yes yes! Little-little guy!
Mm-hmm. Ah, fuck it. I'm sure it'll be fine.
Let's keep the mimic around. Why not?
He mutters to himself, "I can write a book on famous last words after this whole thing..."
Your gloved fist makes contact with the monster before it's able to react.
It lets out a piercing howl.
And then bites you.
In the same motion, the creature slips right off the wall, using its sticky back to grab as much as it can in the process.
The loot! Try to grab the loot!
(Let it go.)
You quickly swipe at the aberration as it scurries across the floor.
Away away! <wiggle>FUCK YOU!</wiggle>
A bag.
It's a bag!
(Grab it.)
Before the mimic escapes through the tunnels behind you, you see the old leather bag it's dragging around, and...
You get a hold of it.
Then the mimic quickly disappears, its scream echoing down the hall.
(Loot the bag.)
Some crowns!
Nice.
And there's something left in the hole in the wall. Take a look.
E-"Loot... acquired."
You quickly attempt to swipe at the aberration as it scurries across the floor.
Away away! <wiggle>DRAT YOU!</wiggle>
(Stumble.)
As the mimic escapes through the tunnels behind you, you see an old leather bag being dragged around behind it.
Damn it! It's gone!
You watch as the mimic rushes away, its scream echoing down the hall.
(Get up and dust yourself off.)
Okay, sorry for not helping there. I really didn't expect that.
But hey. It didn't bite your face off, right?
